newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus in Amaury TV news plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus in Amaury TV news plan - paper.

text.p: French pay-television group Canal Plus is in talks with newspaper publishers Groupe Amaury to set up a television news channel to rival LCI of TF1, said the La Tribune newspaper.
A Canal Plus spokeswoman told Reuters it was no secret that it is preparing a 24-hour news channel but had no immediate comment on a partnership with Amaury.
There was no immediate comment at Amaury, publisher of tabloid Le Parisien Aujourd'hui and the sports daily L'Equipe.

La Tribune said that Canal Plus had charged executive Christian Dutoit with the project to create a news channel to rival and eventually replace La Chaine Info (LCI) on the digital satellite channel CanalSatellite.
LCI is one of the featured channels on TPS, the rival digital satellite project managed by TF1.
Canal Plus chairman Pierre Lescure said in June that his company would decide in mid-August whether to launch a television news channel.
